title: Eleven Lines and One Question
subtitle: 阅读理解 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 阅读理解（生活与学习·阅读与理解）
meta: 主题语境：阅读理解（生活与学习·阅读与理解）　|　核心词汇：comprehension　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comprehension 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my teacher ① tested our comprehension with a passage about a door, and she said the testing was the whole of the lesson. The ② comprehension, meaning the understanding and not the answers, took eleven lines and stayed open; comprehension, she said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how little it can be marked.

Every ③ comprehension in that book had the same last question, and the ④ comprehension at the end, meaning the one she set for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever discussed twice. Comprehension, my mother said, is nine parts reading and one part somebody willing to be wrong; my teacher said the being wrong is the part that fills the margin.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ comprehension was the whole of the apology, meaning the grasping and not the test. The ⑥ comprehension, meaning the grasping and not any of that, is the only thing in an apology that everybody wants and nobody asks for; comprehension, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both an understanding and a grasping. She said the grasping is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ comprehension had become a line in a syllabus, and the syllabus had become an argument about the last question. The ⑧ comprehension of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in March, was one passage and thirty years of reading; comprehension, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to be wrong. He said the being wrong was never mentioned.

The ⑨ comprehension I remember is the one at the end, which she set in 1983 and is still described as the hardest in the school. A ⑩ comprehension, my mother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being discussed; every comprehension, she said, is a grasping that has agreed to look like a test. She said the grasping was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 理解（指那种读懂本身，与那些答案相对）
C. 固定搭配：test one's comprehension 考查理解力
D. n. 阅读理解题（指那本书里每一篇）
E. n. 阅读理解题（指末尾那一篇）
F. n. 理解；谅解（指道歉里那种被理解）
G. n. 阅读理解（指教学大纲里提到的那一项）
H. n. 领悟力（抽象总称）

items.q: tested our comprehension with a passage about a door
The comprehension, meaning the understanding and not the answers
comprehension was the whole of the apology
the comprehension had become a line in a syllabus
The comprehension of the whole thing
A comprehension, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: test one's comprehension 意为“考查理解力”，1969 年老师用一篇关于一扇门的短文考查我们的理解力。
comprehension 意为“理解”，指那种读懂本身而不是那些答案，它占了十一行，并且一直敞着没有收束。
comprehension 指那本书里每一篇阅读理解题，每一篇都有同样的最后一问。
comprehension 指末尾那一篇（她留给考试的那篇），是唯一有人讨论过两次的。
comprehension 意为“理解、谅解”，父亲说理解就是那次道歉的全部，指的是那种被领会而不是那场测验。
comprehension 为抽象用法，指道歉里那种被领会而不是那场测验，是道歉里人人都想要、却无人开口要的东西。
comprehension 意为“阅读理解”，指教学大纲里提到的那一项，到 1977 年阅读理解成了大纲里的一行。
comprehension 意为“领悟力”，老师三月写道，整件事的领悟力是一篇短文三十年的阅读。
comprehension 意为“理解、阅读理解”，我记得的是末尾那一篇，她 1983 年出的，至今仍被说成全校最难的。
comprehension 为抽象总称，母亲说一次阅读理解是唯一会因为被讨论而变好的东西。
